allow: PowerShell($p = Start-Process -FilePath "node" -ArgumentList "node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs","src/server/server.ts" -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8787/" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\), length=$\($r.Content.Length\)"; $r.Content.Substring\(0, 200\) } finally { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force })

PowerShell($pids = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173,8787 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique; foreach \($procId in $pids\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -Confirm:$false } catch {} }; "stopped: $pids")
